model: EE160 humidity and temperature sensor for building automation (RS-485 Modbus RTU)
applies_to: EE160 RH/T room/duct sensor with RS-485 interface in Modbus RTU mode, per user manual BA_EE160 v2.7 (04-2026).
summary: The EE160 is an HVAC humidity and temperature sensor with an RS-485 Modbus RTU port. It gives temperature and relative humidity as 32-bit floats and as 16-bit integers scaled by 100, plus serial number, firmware version and sensor name.

addressing.note: The manual prints a decimal register number starting at 1 and a hex register address starting at 0. Send the hex address: temperature is register 26, address 0x19, and the manual's example request reads 0x0019.

source.title: User Manual EE160 Humidity and Temperature Sensor for Building Automation
source.pages: Modbus settings and device-setup registers pp. 16-17 (Tab. 3-4); measured data p. 17 (Tab. 5); example and float decoding pp. 17-18 (Tab. 6-7)

notes: Float word order: the manual's worked example reads 0x19 and gets 51 F0 41 BA, decoded as IEEE 754 0x41BA51F0 = 23.29 °C. The first register holds the low word, so floats are CDAB.
Metric or US units are fixed by the order code and cannot be changed with PCS10; the unit fields show the metric case.
The integer block uses scale 100 per the manual (2550 = 25.5).
Left out: write-only setup registers 0x00 (Modbus address) and 0x01 (protocol settings); the manual refers to E+E note AN0103 for their coding.
Measured values can be read with function 03 or 04; they are filed here as holding registers.

registers.name: Serial number
registers.description: ASCII text across 8 registers; read all 8.

registers.name: Firmware version
registers.description: High byte = major release, low byte = minor release.

registers.name: Sensor name
registers.description: ASCII text across 8 registers; read all 8.

registers.name: Temperature T (integer)
registers.description: Value x100; °F on non-metric order versions.

integration.summary: Default 9600 baud 8E1, address 245. Read 2 registers at 0x19 for temperature and 2 at 0x1B for humidity (floats, low word first), or 0x12C/0x12D for x100 integers.
integration.enable: Modbus RTU is the interface. Set address and serial settings with PCS10 and the USB-C configuration stick HA011070; a non-zero DIP-switch address overrides any software-set address.
quirks: Read both float registers in one request so both halves match.
Serial number and sensor name need all 8 registers read at once.
setup: Factory settings: 9600 baud, 8 data bits, even parity, 1 stop bit, Modbus address 245.
Selectable: 9600-115200 baud, none/odd/even parity, 1 or 2 stop bits, address 1-247.
All DIP switches at 0 means the address set in PCS10 is used.
A jumper terminates the bus; it is off (not terminated) from the factory.
gotchas: °C vs °F is an order option, not a setting.

verified.method: independent re-check of every register against the source PDF
